verdict.rationale: Ironclad ships contract signing: a product page for signing contracts, an embeddable Ironclad Signature experience for signers, and collection of signed agreements. Its workflows enforce approval and signature policies, and signature requests can be routed through your own provider via BYOSP. The evidence never explicitly covers sending one document to multiple recipients with a defined signing order, or the legal-binding guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit multi-recipient and signing-order routing docs, a legally binding or compliance statement (e.g., ESIGN/eIDAS), and independent hands-on corroboration of signing flows.
